scope: My Page profile/avatar editor and centralized character schedule management
browser: isolated Chromium with 1440px, 768px, 390px and 320px viewport emulation

checks: Profile menu exposes My Page
Old avatar-only menu label is removed
My Page has its own authenticated route and page title
Previously saved character memories are visible in the central list
Profile name and avatar save without leaving My Page
Profile and avatar persist across a normal reload
Profile draft changes can be reverted
Empty schedule title cannot be saved
New schedule stores its character, date and appointment time
Adding a schedule preserves existing events
Character filter scopes the shared schedule list
Reassigning an event moves it out of the previous character filter
Edited event retains its identity without duplication
Edited schedule persists across reload with no lost events
Deleting a schedule removes only that event
Past event is excluded from upcoming events
Past events have their own filter
All events view includes upcoming and historical schedules
768px: profile and schedule fit the viewport
390px: profile and schedule fit the viewport
320px: profile and schedule fit the viewport
Character page opens My Page filtered to that character
Study preparation opens the central editor with its room character
Returning from central schedules restores goal and conversation option
Saving from preparation marks that room prompt complete
First-time avatar setup still completes with the shared customizer
No runtime or console errors

limitations: Physical mobile devices and other browser engines were not exercised.
Data stays in the frontend demo; no calendar sync or reminder service is connected.
artifacts: Development-only screenshots and runner in /private/tmp/capsule-mypage-review and /private/tmp/capsule-wireframe-browser/mypage-qa.mjs.
